sentences.en: He tried to elucidate the complex rules of the game.
sentences.zh: 他试图阐明游戏的复杂规则。

sentences.en: The teacher elucidated the main points at the beginning of class.
sentences.zh: 老师在课一开始便阐明了主要要点。

sentences.en: She elucidated her argument in great detail during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她在会议上详细阐明了自己的论点。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（加强）+lucid（照亮）+ate→弄清晰→阐明
